mapper.insert: insert into coupon (name, discount_type, discount, total_count, remained_count, begin_time, end_time, create_time, update_time) values (#{name}, #{discountType}, #{discount}, #{totalCount}, #{remainedCount}, #{beginTime}, #{endTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select * from coupon order by id desc
mapper.update: update coupon set remained_count = remained_count - 1, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and remained_count > 0
